briefing: I keep the books here at {HERE}, and some entries need a quiet hand. A sealed packet has to reach a neighbour, and neither end asks questions.
You don't open it, and you don't sit on it while you run other errands. One jump, one drop, and you're finished with me.
dossier.lead: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD}, asking for a moment of the commander's time.

run.arrive: Take the packet to {TARGET}, and don't ask what's inside.
run.success: The packet reached {TARGET}, and {PAY} clears the books.
run.fail: The packet never reached {TARGET}, and {PAY} stays uncollected.

dossier.news: Dockhands at {WORLD} say {PATRON} is short a courier and paying well for silence.

rumour.far: Talk on the boards says {PATRON} at {WORLD} has a packet nobody wants opened.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD}: the packet is still waiting, and so is the fee.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander agreed to carry a sealed packet from {WORLD}.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the packet had reached its neighbour, and {WORLD} heard nothing more of it.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the packet had gone nowhere, and {WORLD} was left waiting on it.

run.success: On day {DAY}, the commander delivered the sealed packet to {WORLD} without incident.
run.failed: On day {DAY}, the packet missed its window, and {WORLD} never saw it arrive.

dossier.title: No Questions Asked
